title: Autopsy and Cipher
author: Noor Blackwood
blurb: Beatrix Whitlock, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
